News global nation business lifestyle entertainment technology sports opinion LATEST NEWS STORIES HEADLINES METRO REGIONS NATION WORLD CDN NEWSLETTER www / Philippine Elections Philippine Elections NEWS BRIEFS Comelec warns vs fake post on BSKE sked Philippine Daily Inquirer / 05:30 AM October 24, 2026 Share: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Elections (Comelec) on Friday warned the public against another fake social media post claiming that the Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE) would push through in December.
READ: SC asks gov’t to comment on petition vs deferment of barangay, SK polls
The poll body debunked on Facebook a post by Gallaza Sharly Paradise claiming that the elections would be held that month and the filing of certificates of candidacy (COCs) would begin on Oct. 26.
“There will be no Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) elections this year under the current law, and the filing of [COCs] scheduled for Oct. 26, 2026, will not take place,” the Comelec said. President Marcos signed Republic Act No. 12326 into law on Sept. 24, extending the terms of barangay and youth officials from three years to five years. As a result, the next BSKE was moved to November 2028. —Chelsy Claire Perez
